outputs.Decision_and_explanation: FAIL: the top graph in panel C is a box plot showing polyp numbers per mouse with visible whiskers, but the caption gives only n numbers and P-values ('n=8–18 per genotype'; '*P<0.05; ***P<0.001') without stating what the box, median line or whiskers represent (e.g., quartiles, min/max, SD).
FAIL: the bar graph quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 shows error bars, but the caption does not state what they represent (no mention of SD, SEM, or replicate number).

FAIL: the 'Relative expression' bar graph (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) shows error bars with significance markers, but the caption only reports P-value thresholds ('*P<0.05') without defining the error bar type (e.g., SD, SEM) or sample size.
